Postgraduate students（3 years）:（1）Possess a bachelor's degree;（2）Possess the ability understanding the lectures in English or in Chinese (HSK 4).（3）Do good or excellent during study.Pattern of StudyInternational students can choose to study in classes with Chinese students taught in Chinese, and a separated class taught in English.1. Classes with Chinese students: The taught language is Chinese. The Chinese Proficiency should pass HSK Band 4.2. Separated Class taught in English: If students apply for the same specialty at the same term taught in English, a separated class may be offered.
